introHtml: Port Authority shirts are a top choice for corporate uniforms and team apparel because of their consistent quality and professional fit. The easy-care fabric resists wrinkles, making these shirts ideal for employees who need a polished look all day. Choose from long-sleeve, Oxford, or knit dress shirt styles, all available with your logo embroidered or screen printed. Perfect for trade shows, office wear, or promotional events.
